statements: the voice should be prepared whole, changed instantly like Apple's, in better quality
improve Ketmix to Apple Music's level, researching everywhere
a better Ket 27, offered as a large multiple choice (all choices taken; the collapsing tab bar optional in settings)
the launcher icon from four images the owner generated, with previews in the app, backgrounds removed keeping the liquid glass
make progressive streaming really work, very high quality loading fast and smoothly

done.voice: VoiceStage runs from stream start when a model is installed and takes masks up live; survives speed-change flushes; mask interpolated in time and extended above 11 kHz (also in Separator.stem); separation starts with the lyrics screen and is upgraded by the HQ model; lyrics follow the stage delay
done.ketmix: tempoRange 4/6/8 % with TempoReturn back to the native tempo after the blend (owner lifted the no-speed-change rule); mid-band EQ at 1 kHz held back on one deck at a time (-4 dB, -8 dB on clashes), measured -8.0 dB at 1 kHz in DeckDspTest; crossfades on phrases, halved on key clashes
done.progressive: upgrade waits for playback then retries once; renditions aligned by loudness-envelope correlation (137 ms recovered within 2.5 ms in QualityHandoffTest), different songs rejected; equal-power crossfade; progressiveQuality on by default
done.icons: owner's four images matted (tools/icons), each laid on the ground it was drawn on because Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black (a transparent background is not possible; the owner asked for one and is told), previews in the picker
done.ket27: three sub-agents (look, navigation, screens) built glass transparency levels, tilt reflections, cover colours with WCAG checks, full-bleed player, Home cards, Library/Downloads pills and grids, lyrics mesh and word halo, floating search, cover zoom, optional collapsing tab bar; merged with one conflict resolved by the main agent

not_validated: physical phone or Quest installation, rendering, touch, sensors and keyboard behaviour
real glass blur and refraction of the new screens (flat in host renders)
tilt reflections' feel; cover-zoom with the back gesture; the search bubble with the keyboard
Ketmix tempo glide and mid EQ by ear on real songs
progressive handoff on real streams from different providers (alignment, crossfade, timing)
the voice stage's CPU cost on a phone and live mask take-up by ear
independent code review of the main agent's diff (the sub-agents' diffs were reviewed only through their reports, renders and tests)
known_limitations: Songs are played about 0.09 s later whenever a separation model is installed (the voice stage runs from the start of every stream); the lyrics compensate.
Launcher icons keep a background: Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black.
Streams made of many small files (DASH, HLS) cannot be separated whole for the voice level.
Being a beta tag, the in-app updater does not offer it to users of a stable version; it is offered on the website and the releases page.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
